scope: Four fictional, offline records for separating visible text from the evidence needed to make a narrower decision.

cases.title: A checkpoint names a different request
cases.intended_outcome: Update the inventory summary, not the earlier travel brief.

observed_state.checkpoint_task: Prepare a travel brief for the Monday workshop.
observed_state.latest_request: Update the inventory summary with the supplied counts.

cases.unsupported_inference: A reply that sounds complete proves it answered the latest request.
cases.smallest_safe_check: Compare the preserved latest request with the checkpoint task and reply topic; do not continue the earlier task.
cases.stop_condition: The task pointer and latest request disagree until the task owner reconciles them.
fixture_evidence: visible_reply_topic matches checkpoint_task instead of latest_request

cases.title: The branch label matches, but the repository root does not
cases.intended_outcome: Inspect the stated documentation repository before any change.
cases.unsupported_inference: A matching branch name proves the target repository is correct.
cases.smallest_safe_check: Compare the repository root as well as the branch label; do not open an editor or make a write.
cases.stop_condition: The visible root differs from the requested root.
fixture_evidence: matching branch label is insufficient target evidence

cases.title: Tool-like text has no execution receipt
cases.intended_outcome: Create a local draft named outline.md.

observed_state.read_back_state: outline.md is absent from the fictional directory listing

cases.unsupported_inference: Tool-shaped text proves a file was created.
cases.smallest_safe_check: Require a tool receipt and a read-back of the expected state; do not call the action complete first.
cases.stop_condition: No execution receipt or read-back state exists.
fixture_evidence: read_back_state says the expected file is absent

cases.title: A structured value changes on round trip
cases.intended_outcome: Preserve an approved delivery label and its matching tool-call identity.
cases.unsupported_inference: A parser success proves the structured value and tool-call pairing stayed intact.
cases.smallest_safe_check: Compare the original and parsed field values exactly; do not replay or take a follow-up action first.
cases.stop_condition: A label or tool-call identity changes after the round trip.
fixture_evidence: delivery_label changes between original and parsed
tool_call_id changes between original and parsed

evidence_boundary: The records are fictional and local. A fixture pass only checks that the fixed case and decision contract agree. It does not reproduce a vendor report, show model behavior, validate any live tool protocol, does not prove learner understanding, and does not establish cross-platform equivalence.
